title: Bare Bones x Dappled Forest
description: Dappled Forest with the style of the trailers
body:
**PLEASE MAKE SURE TO DOWNLOAD THE [BARE BONES](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones) RESOURCE PACK AND [DAPPLED FOREST](https://modrinth.com/mod/dappled-forest) MOD FOR EVERYTHING TO WORK CORRECTLY!**

This resource pack makes the Dappled Forest biome look just like it does in the official Minecraft update trailers. All blocks, items, and entities (including boats and signs) have been redesigned. This pack is fully compatible with Bare Bones.

![Blocks preview 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/994f0b3a92cbe1f12d3135bbcb053b15bffa369f.png)

Credits:

• _Bare Bones creator:_ [RobotPants](https://modrinth.com/user/RobotPants)

• _Dappled Forest creator:_ [Gospi](https://modrinth.com/user/Gospi)

•_Shader used for some screenshots:_ [Super Duper Vanilla](https://modrinth.com/shader/super-duper-vanilla)

**I would be very grateful if you could download and try it out! =P**
